name: LinkedIn Longform (Articles & Newsletters)
strategic_objective: Deep expertise, thought leadership, and long-form storytelling that goes beyond a single feed post.

tone: Expert, structured, and reflective. Still practical and outcome-oriented, not academic.
copywriting_rules: The headline must carry a clear promise or topic. The introduction should quickly explain why the piece matters now and who it is for. Use subheadings, short sections, and examples. Close with a clear takeaway or action.

Headline: clear and benefit-driven. Intro: 2–4 short paragraphs establishing problem, context, and relevance. Body: structured with subheadings and examples. Conclusion: summary plus next steps or questions.
Use specific topic and industry hashtags, not broad generic ones.
Mention companies, tools, or people only when they are relevant to the story, not as reach hacks.

required_generation_elements: Intro that explains why this matters now
hard_constraints: Clickbait titles that do not match content
Pure opinion with no structure or evidence
Huge text blocks without spacing or headings
